from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics extracted from one company's 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name from this filing")
    filing_period: str | None = Field(description="The quarter-end date as YYYY-MM")
    net_income: float | None = Field(description="Net Income/Loss for the quarter; negative for loss")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of net_income: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total Assets at period end")
    total_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of total_assets: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    weighted_avg_diluted_shares_current: float | None = Field(description="Weighted-Average Diluted Shares Outstanding for current quarter")
    weighted_avg_diluted_shares_current_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of current shares: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    weighted_avg_diluted_shares_prior: float | None = Field(description="Weighted-Average Diluted Shares Outstanding for same period prior year")
    weighted_avg_diluted_shares_prior_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of prior shares: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancials]
